clips.title: The story
paras: Elder Bloodhoof is an ancestral spirit found resting just north of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. Appearing prominently to travelers during the Lunar Festival, he stands as a revered guardian spirit of the Bloodhoof tribe.

Elder Bloodhoof represents the deep spiritual bond the tauren share with their lineage. Manifesting near Bloodhoof Village, this ghostly elder watches over his people and rewards respectful travelers who seek wisdom during the Lunar Festival. His presence reinforces the enduring guidance of deceased chieftains and tribal forebears, whose spirits remain intimately tied to the plains of Mulgore.
